verdict.rationale: First-party docs show an organization can hold multiple depository accounts (checking/savings) and move money between them via the internal-transfer endpoint. A long-time customer reports running "dozens of purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules." However, no first-party documentation describes rules that automatically split incoming deposits across sub-accounts, so the auto-allocation half rests on a single community report. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of opening multiple checking sub-accounts, documented auto-allocation or percentage-split rules for incoming deposits, and corroborating hands-on evidence.
